# Vendored rhai-lsp crates

`rhai-rowan`, `rhai-hir` and `rhai-sourcegen` from https://github.com/rhaiscript/lsp at commit
`2f1fcd73f43b909d1d5e96123516e599b9aaaa88`, plus small local patches for rhai 1.27
(see `git log -- vendor/rhai-lsp`). WireLab uses them for live script linting. Licence: LICENSE.md.
